Node 22.22.2 / V8 12.4.254.21-node.39 MathHypot allocates a FixedDoubleArray, normalizes by maximum magnitude, and uses Kahan summation. For two finite inputs, first compensation is exactly zero, so the result is sqrt((abs(x)/max)^2 + (abs(y)/max)^2) * max, retaining input order. Both zero returns positive zero; any nonfinite magnitude delegates to Math.hypot, preserving infinity/NaN behavior. No approximation, reciprocal multiplication, fast-math, changed judge, search, scoring or physics.
